answer_1.quote: Automatic metrics are an indispensable part of machine translation (MT) evaluation, serving as a proxy to human evaluation which is considerably more expensive and time-consuming.
answer_1.outputs: MT outputs or set of translations

answer_2.quote: Automatic metrics compute the quality of an MT output (or set of translations) by comparing it with a reference translation by a human translator.

answer_4.quote: Following , we use direct assessment (DA) scores collected as part of the human evaluation at WMT 2019. Annotators are asked to rate the adequacy of a set of translations compared to the corresponding source/reference sentence on a slider which maps to a continuous scale between 0 and 100.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to rate the adequacy of a set of translations compared to the corresponding source/reference sentence on a slider which maps to a continuous scale between 0 and 100.
